production.note: US model years. KBB lists the 430 Scuderia for 2008 ('2008 Ferrari 430 Scuderia Price, Value & Reviews', kbb-430scud-2008) and 2009 only. Evo: the car was to be 'officially unveiled by Michael Schumacher' at the September 2007 Frankfurt show (as reported in evo-430scud-news). The Scuderia Spider 16M is a separate model.

body.note: Two-seat mid-engined berlinetta; the open car is the separately named Scuderia Spider 16M.

displacementL.note: 4,308 cc. Evo: 'the 4308cc V8'. Ferrari's page: 'Total displacement 263 cu in'.

aspiration.note: No forced induction on Ferrari's specification (compression ratio 11.88:1); inferred.

fuel.note: Petrol V8; inferred from the description.

drivetrain.note: Mid-engined, rear-wheel drive with Ferrari's 'Electronic differential E-Diff2' and F1-Trac; inferred from the description.

transmission.note: Evo: 'the latest 'Superfast' software for the F1 paddle-shift gearbox, cutting gearchange times to a mere 60 milliseconds'. KBB 2008: 'Transmission 6 speed' (kbb-430scud-2008). No manual was offered; Ferrari F1 is an automated manual.

powerHp.note: Ferrari's rating is metric: 510 CV x 0.98632 = 503.0 hp. Quote (Ferrari): "Maximum power 375,4 kW (510 CV) at 8500 rpm" (reproduced on a second request). Evo: 'the 4308cc V8 now putting out 503bhp at 8500rpm (up 20bhp on the standard car' (evo-430scud-news). KBB prints the CV number as hp: '510 @ 8500 RPM' (kbb-430scud-2008). No separate US SAE rating was found, so powerStandard is DIN PS.

weightLb.note: Ferrari's own figure in pounds. Quote (Ferrari): "Kerb weight 2975 lb*" (beside "Dry weight 2775 lb*"; reproduced on two further requests). The asterisk's footnote was not reproduced on the page, so it is not known whether the figure assumes optional equipment. Step 1 of the weight order. KBB 2008 gives the same figure, '2975 lbs.' (kbb-430scud-2008); Evo's launch report estimated '1335kg 'wet'' before Ferrari's figures were out. Only the F1 gearbox was offered.

discrepancies.reason: KBB prints Ferrari's metric CV figure as horsepower; Evo converts it to 503 bhp.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 503 hp, Ferrari's 510 CV converted at 0.98632.
